chapter: Parisian Room and Bourbon Street clubs
title: Fazola, Federico, Butera and other Parisian Room players
summary: Steinau names players he heard at the Parisian Room, including Fazola, Frank Federico and Sam DeKemel, and dates his visits to 1947-48.
